title: The parts of exudyn.HT and exudyn.Twist as read-only numpy views instead of copies
author: Claude-JG
description: Revision2026c step RG12.69.7. rotation and translation of exudyn.HT, velocity and angularVelocity of exudyn.Twist are read-only numpy views of the memory of the object, which they keep alive, instead of new arrays: a Python forceUserFunction of ObjectConnectorUser reads four of them per call (#3183). A view follows later changes of the object; np.array(...) copies. Decided: views.
releaseNotes: rotation and translation of exudyn.HT, velocity and angularVelocity of exudyn.Twist are read-only numpy views of the object instead of copies: they follow its later changes, writing into them raises, np.array(...) copies; a Python user function of ObjectConnectorUser reads them faster.
